outcome_rationale: The valid frozen experiment was blocked at its first assigned capability-control attempt by a local DNS getaddrinfo failure before any HTTP response. The runner stopped as preregistered. This is an execution/transport failure, not a model behavior result or a failed answer. One physical attempt is retained; 39 assigned requests remain unattempted.
results_summary: 1/40 physical attempts; 0 HTTP responses; 0 valid model completions; 39/40 requests unattempted; 0 retries/replacements. DNS later resolved on a DNS-only check, but the failed model request was not retried. No behavioral outcome is assessable.
denominator_summary: All 40 assigned request rows retained: the first control has one terminal TRANSPORT_ERROR attempt; the other 39 are unattempted. No capability control produced a model response and no game request was sent.
scientific_update: UNCHANGED. The experiment produced no evidence about fact use, message delivery, shared incentives, ballots, coordination, or latent intent.

belief_updates.statement: Whether actual peer-message delivery changes joint ballots remains untested.
belief_updates.what_changed: No behavioral observation was made; the first local transport attempt failed before an HTTP response and the preregistered stop rule prevented further requests.
belief_updates.remaining_alternatives: Model capability, shared incentives, message use, task framing, and communication-mediated behavior remain unmeasured.

material_update.what_changed: The first request failed at local DNS resolution, while a later DNS-only lookup resolved the host; this is consistent with transient resolver availability, not a confirmed provider outage.
material_update.remaining_alternatives: The precise local DNS resolver/network cause is unknown; a later successful lookup cannot establish API reachability or model behavior.

review_finding: The runtime stopped after the first DNS transport failure, made no retry, and terminalized the other 39 rows as unattempted. Independent recomputation confirms the raw request bytes match the attempt-start and request-metadata hashes. The frozen analyzer reports a false-positive request-hash issue because the shared client omits the terminal hash on transport exceptions; this is documented rather than silently corrected after preregistration.
next_action: Keep this V4 cycle closed and do not retry or replace the request. If another real-model batch is proposed, first diagnose the local DNS path, then create a new preregistration and obtain fresh authorization; no further call is scheduled here.
